strategy.title: What If We Experienced the Universe at 10× Scale?
strategy.hook: Changing one condition turns the observable universe into a thought experiment with surprising consequences.

story_structure.opening: Establish normal the observable universe and clearly identify the single rule that will change.
story_structure.escalation: Follow three cause-and-effect consequences, increasing the stakes at each step.
story_structure.takeaway: Return to reality and show what the scenario reveals about how the observable universe actually works.

strategy.audience: Curious learners who save and share clear visual explanations.
strategy.visual_direction: Cause-and-effect triptych for the observable universe; normal baseline on left, altered 10× world at center, cascading consequences on right, cinematic visual continuity
